reality_delta: The main AI moved from an artifact-less plan to concrete runtime changes with line-level semantic traceability, explicit validator thresholds, and non-trivial negative tests. The prism-shard validator now behaviorally rejects unsafe configurations rather than merely documenting them, and the archaeology check enforces extraction traceability as a hard dependency.
main_concern: Residual risk that the line-number traceability proves provenance but not correct semantic interpretation; the main AI still selected, named, and mapped the five defense strategies. However, this risk is now bounded and auditable rather than hidden.
top_risks: The five mapped strategies may be an incomplete or slightly mischaracterized reading of the old source; a future 360-degree scan could encounter an unextracted edge case.

The validator thresholds are strict (index-first only, provider-output-only, max_source_files >= 1) and could reject legitimate future shard designs that the old source might have allowed under careful conditions.
The passing checks are self-reported; if the check logic was co-evolved with the implementation to match, they provide less independent validation than assumed.
missing_evidence: An independent second-pass read of the old source lines 7-10, 17-24, 26-36, 42-49, 72-89 to confirm the extraction semantics match the original intent.
A realistic integration test where the hardened prism-shard validator processes an actual candidate shard configuration from a pending task.
Evidence that the negative test cases are exercised by the continuous check pipeline rather than only on-demand self-check.
minimum_fix: No blocking fix required. Recommend scheduling a spot-check during the first real 360-degree scan to validate that the five extracted strategies actually prevent context blow-up in practice; if they fail, treat it as an extraction revision rather than a runtime bug.

anti_loop_signal.reason: The iterative pattern is healthy, not loopy: request → concern about missing artifacts → artifacts added → concern about semantic fidelity → traceability and negative tests added. Each cycle addressed the prior concern with new substance rather than reframing.

user_intent_alignment: Well aligned. The bounded preparation task is executed with real behavioral changes, constraints are respected, and the extraction is scoped to a single named old source without bulk reads or ledger imports. The runtime hardening makes later scanning safer rather than merely documenting intent.
